From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@bancorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood evals for Bancorp

Tom — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to get a customer-specific eval running on Redwood.

Recap / Goals
- Objective: validate model fit for Bancorp's customer support summarization and compliance classification flows.
- Success criteria: automated metrics (token-level F1, exact-match for classification labels) + human QA for edge cases. Target: automated pass >= 80% on core set, no high-severity regressions.

Recommended baseline models to evaluate
- Llama-2-Chat-70B (highest quality baseline)
- Redwood-13B-v2 (quantized 4-bit) — good quality / cost tradeoff
- Mistral-Instruct-7B — throughput-optimized alternative

Data & eval setup (what we need from Bancorp)
- Small sample dataset (min 500 examples) in JSONL: each line {"input": ..., "expected": ..., "metadata": {source, use_case}}. See attached sample_prompt_set.jsonl.
- Scoring: exact-match for discrete labels; token-level F1 for free-text summaries; human pass/fail for ambiguous cases.
- PII handling: if dataset contains PII, please indicate and we can run on a Private deployment or with retention controls.

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Share sample dataset (500 rows) and annotate any PII or retention requirements.
2) Confirm preferred models to include in the run (we recommend running all three above initially).
3) We'll provision a Redwood eval project and share a secure upload link (S3 or Google Drive) + initial leaderboard within 48 hours of receiving data.

Attachments: sample_prompt_set.jsonl (sample format)

If this all looks good I’ll loop in Neha (onboarding) to provision the eval.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Thanks Tom — that timeline works. A few clarifications re: PII and the eval workflow:

- Private deployment: yes, we can run the sensitive subset on a Private deployment (VPC or on-premises slot) and apply customer-managed KMS for keys. We'll also tag that run as "no retention" or a configurable retention window — please indicate your preferred retention (default is 30 days).
- SOC2/compliance evidence: attaching a stub SOC2-evidence.pdf — we can provide the full pack via our security portal once we have an NDA in place.
- Dataset upload options: secure S3 bucket (we can provide a pre-signed URL) or a restricted Drive folder (Drive link in metadata). Please avoid sending unencrypted attachments over email.

Scoring rubric (more detail):
- Classification: exact-match on label codes. Automated pass if exact-match >= 85%.
- Summarization: token-level F1 + BLEU as a tie-breaker. Automated pass if F1 >= 0.78.
- Human review: we'll sample edge cases (5% stratified sample) and report pass/fail with rationale.

Once you share the sample dataset I'll have Neha onboard the project and provision the eval. Attaching eval_onboarding.md for what we'll run by default (models, config, metrics).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence.pdf, eval_onboarding.md

Neha / Rishi — heads-up on a new eval kickoff for Bancorp (DEAL-3491). Tom expects ~700 sample rows by EOD Thursday. Key asks below so we can be ready to ingest ASAP once data lands.

Requested provisioning
- Project id: BANCORP-EVAL-3491
- Models to run (initial): Llama-2-Chat-70B, Redwood-13B-v2 (4-bit quant), Mistral-Instruct-7B
- Default run config: max_tokens=1024, temperature=0.2, top_p=0.9, batch_size tuned to throughput
- Metrics: classification exact-match, token-level F1 for summaries, BLEU (tie-breaker), human pass/fail sample (5% stratified)
- Data format: JSONL with fields: "input", "expected", "metadata.source", "metadata.use_case". See attached sample_prompt_set.jsonl.
- Security: make a Private-run template for any dataset flagged "sensitive". Apply customer KMS + 30-day retention unless Tom/Amira ask otherwise.

Deliverables / timeline
- Provision eval project and pre-create the leaderboard + model variants by EOD 4/23.
- Prepare pre-signed S3 upload and share with Marissa once ready.

Attachments to reference: sample_prompt_set.jsonl, eval_onboarding.md, SOC2-evidence.pdf

Looping Rishi for assistance on the Private-run template and Neha for onboarding. Let me know if you need anything else to stand this up quickly.

Thanks,
Marissa
